heading: Help us build AI that ships, not just demos.
description: We're a small, founder-led team building an Enterprise AI Academy, an AI consulting practice, and a portfolio of AI products — all held to the same production bar. Right now, that team is the two of us.
noRolesNote: No open roles right now — but if you want to build production AI with us, tell us what you'd bring and we'll keep you in mind for what's next.
